hypothesis: Active Quaternary normal faults and blind range-front geothermal conduits in the Great Basin localize at the piedmont-range-front transition where bedrock steps down across a subsurface density gradient (Band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope) into moderate alluvial cover (Band 15 depth_to_base_surf, Band 12 det_elev), expressing at the surface as a sharp relative break-in-slope ||grad(det_elev_slope)||/(det_elev_slope+2 deg) (Band 19) along an orientation-coherent lineament (Band 12). Unnormalized BREAKLINE placed 74.8% of its far dots in steep mountain range interiors; normalizing by background slope and gating by the piedmont gravity-cover envelope concentrates 82.5% of far candidates in the piedmont while repairing R0's post-b2 skeleton holes.
mechanism: At fixed S=37,654 unit-mass dots, on-skeleton dots (N_skel = 37,654 - N_far) keep the highest-w_pf R0 dots and refill 4,000 piedmont H19-5 holes (left when R0 pruned d_cat<=2 after D2.8 thinning) via exact marginal expected-DTI greedy under S_pct. Off-skeleton dots (N_far in {13179, 15062, 16944}, 35/40/45%) are placed by spaced_top_mask (2.8 px floor) on S_raw strictly >3 px off H19-5 and >3 px off prior off-skeleton lanes' far sets.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan wave-cut shoreline terraces and beach ridges at piedmont elevations (~1,200-1,330 m AMSL) overlying regional basin-margin gravity gradients, incised alluvial-fan terrace risers (fan-head trenches), and pediment-alluvium contacts.
falsifier: Pooled HOLDOUT-DTI failing to beat both R0 (0.004006) and the holdout best RELIEF p10 (0.006045) with paired 95% CI excluding 0, or SGMC off-catalogue DTI falling below R0 (0.096060), or any single-feature leakage canary > 0.90, or local registry forward overlap > 0.70 / |rho| > 0.90.

holdout_dti.dose_note: All three PIEDFRONT doses (0.006425, 0.006402, 0.006137) exceed R0 (0.004006) and prior holdout best RELIEF p10 (0.006045) in point estimate on gems57-pooled-hide-v2; f35Ptop is the primary dose (highest HOLDOUT-DTI, highest SGMC among the three doses, and paired delta vs f45Ptop +0.000287 [+0.000027, +0.000548]).

sgmc_control_proxy.note: PIEDFRONT intentionally shifts off-skeleton dots out of steep mountain-interior pre-Quaternary bedrock (where unnormalized BREAKLINE placed 74.8% of its far dots) into the piedmont range-front transition (78.7% of f35Ptop far dots, 73.9% overall). Consequently it achieves the repository's highest non-collar HOLDOUT-DTI (0.006425) on Quaternary/geothermal catalogue faults while scoring lower (0.059993 vs R0 0.096060) on exposed mountain-core SGMC bedrock faults.
